## Teaching

During my time at the University of Rochester, I have been instructor of record in five terms, including Calculus II this semester, Linear Algebra and Differential Equations (online), and Introduction to Probability (online). I have also led workshops for calculus courses over four semesters, where students rated my teaching 4.57/5 overall (58 respondents).

This semester, I am also leading an undergraduate reading course on the combinatorics of the simple random walk.

You can view the courses I have taught along with my teaching evaluations here:

[Teaching](files/Teaching.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Service and Leadership

I also have responsibilities within the department, including mentoring, service, and graduate student leadership. I am the president of the AMS Graduate Student Chapter, organise the Graduate Student Seminar, and mentor an undergraduate research project on directed polymers. You can find more information here:
